_help: Patch correspondence plus Q8/256 pixel depth and robust 3D rigid alignment; bxf is pixel*mm. ROI uses full source coordinates, zero width/height selects full image. Extrinsics maps camera coordinates to body x-forward/y-left/z-up and includes camera lever arm. Confirm measured extrinsics before enabling a real slip decision. Weak texture, missing Q8, bad residual or time gap returns unavailable. This is local visual motion, not IMU fusion or a globally drift-free pose.
